records.decision: Do not add SessionStart, SessionEnd, or Setup to HookEvent or provide SDK hook callbacks for them.
records.reason: They fire in the CLI before the SDK connection is established, so SDK callbacks would never execute.

records.decision: When adding a hook event to HookEvent, also define its matching <Event>HookInput and <Event>HookSpecificOutput types.
Quote SQLite identifiers (table, column, database names) with `escape_sqlite()` rather than hand-written `[{name}]` bracket interpolation in query builders.
records.reason: Raw bracket interpolation lets malicious names containing `]` break out of quoting and inject SQL.

records.decision: Keep `escape_sqlite()` using standard SQLite double-quoted identifier escaping (doubling embedded `"`), not square-bracket quoting.
records.reason: SQLite has no reliable escape for an embedded `]` inside bracket-quoted identifiers.

records.decision: Enable the `transformOptimizedDeps` plugin option for Cloudflare Vite setups (set by `sentryCloudflareVitePlugin`) so build-time instrumentation runs on Vite's pre-bundled dependencies, but do not enable it for Node servers.
records.reason: Cloudflare's Vite plugin pre-bundles Worker deps into node_modules/.vite/deps_*, while Node servers are instrumented by the runtime hook.

records.decision: Use a Rolldown plugin for Vite 8 and an esbuild plugin for Vite 6 and 7 when hooking into the Vite dependency optimizer.
records.reason: Vite 8 uses Rolldown for dependency optimization while Vite 6/7 use esbuild.

records.decision: Avoid calling `getClient` when the client can be obtained another way; use it sparingly.
records.reason: Multi-client usage is already fragile and extra `getClient` calls make it worse.

records.decision: Use `GEN_AI_CONVERSATION_ID` from `@sentry/conventions/attributes` instead of the deprecated core conversation-ID constant.
records.reason: Attribute constants should come from the shared conventions package; the core constant is deprecated but kept exported.
